## aae737932036

**Finding type: reproduced teaching defect.** Audited generator SHA-256: `976a9e1496e37af6b4e4e03ee06480998cc283c97b5f67fae84b7f81ea8f7f71`; no audited source was modified.

The generator samples interior `1` walls and colored markers independently and declares no lesson schedule that guarantees a demonstration where an interior wall changes a marker's destination. At seed `35`, sample indices `0..3`, the first three generated pairs are exactly compatible with the rival `global_column_pack_skipping_ones`: preserve all `1` cells, collect every colored marker in a whole column, and pack them into the lowest non-`1` cells without treating interior `1` cells as segment boundaries. The selected Racket rule and rival differ on zero cells in all three demonstrations but differ on four cells in query index 3. Thus the query introduces the segmentation behavior that the demonstrations do not teach.

Reproduction: `checks/audit/aae737932036/missing_segment_boundary_lesson.json`. It contains all four inputs, selected-Racket outputs, rival outputs, source/rule hashes, and differing cells. Regenerator: `checks/audit/build_repros.py`. Command from packet root: `RACKET_PATH=WORK/.review/racket-runtime/racket/bin/racket PYTHONPATH=WORK/repo/src:WORK/repo/shared/runtime python3 WORK/checks/audit/build_repros.py`.

Limit: this proves one deterministic four-pair window admits the rival; it does not estimate frequency or claim the rival is a common human error.
